package_info.package_versions: All future versions (post-April 14, 2024) will not be published to npm; previous versions up to 0.18.5 remain on npm
package_info.why_malicious: There is no evidence or report of malicious code in the official 'xlsx' (SheetJS) package. The article discusses the project's removal from the npm registry due to policy, legal, and trust issues, not due to malware or supply chain compromise.

detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: There is no indication of malware or supply chain attack in the official 'xlsx' (SheetJS) package per the provided report. However, users should be vigilant for potential typosquatting or impersonation packages that may appear on npm after the official package is removed. Monitor for new or suspicious packages with similar names (e.g., 'xlsx', 'sheetjs', 'xlsxx', etc.) and validate the source and code integrity before use.
